elements.subject: Backlogs should include tasks from subprojects

description.raw:
It would be great if task from subprojects included in a version of a project appear in the backlogs module.

We have a project with a common SPRINT version for our Dev Team, who is working in different projects (which are subjproject of this one) and we want to use the taskboard as a common for that sprint.

Do you see it useful (or another way to accomplish that)?

Only tasks of that project are in the overview _\[request to be changed\]_ # Acceptance criteria **In Backlogs** * In the taskboard: all tasks in the version are shown _\[Priority 1\]_ # Nice to have **In Backlogs** * In the burndown chart: all tasks in the version are shown _\[Priority 2\]_ **In Roadmap** * The “related workpackages” list of all tasks, with a reference to the originating project (name before / after workpackage number and name) _\[Priority 3\]_ * When following link “x open”; an overview of all tasks in the version is shown. _\[Priority 4\]_ # References (similar requests) * A similar request. Differing from the request though; I do not see a full list of workpackages in the roadmap (as per screenshot above): https://community.openproject.com/projects/openproject/work\_packages/17189/activity. * A discussion on the forum describing the request: https://community.openproject.com/topics/3236 Althought there seemed to be some support for the idea, the linked Pull Request is still on hold? https://github.com/finnlabs/openproject-backlogs/pull/233 This pull request is only focussing on subprojects though… * A similar request, focussed on sharing across subprojects, which is still a limitation which I do not see the need for. https://community.openproject.com/projects/plugin-backlogs/work\_packages/22319/activity * A similar request. also focussed on subprojects only: https://community.openproject.com/projects/plugin-backlogs/work\_packages/24971/activity * A request to remove limiting project\\\_id in the selection criteria of the overview; which might enable the requested functionality?: https://community.openproject.com/projects/plugin-backlogs/workpackages/24038/activity I tried the suggested hack, without success though, which might be related to the fact that the tasks are from different projects (not only subproject-relationship). # Next steps * I highly value your efforts and the Openproject software and hope by bringing this together, the software can be enhanced even further. description.html:
Description

as an OpenProject user
I want to have an overview on all tasks included in a (global) sprint/version, independent in which project they are residing
so that the team managing multiple smaller projects, has a global view on the status of the version.

Current behavior

  • A version/sprint can be created in a project, and shared with all projects. [as expected]
  • Tasks/Stories from other projects can be assigned to this version. [as expected]

In Backlogs

  • The versions are shown, including originating from other projects [as expected]
  • In the taskboard: only tasks from current project are shown [request to be changed]
  • In the burndown chart: only tasks from current project are shown [request to be changed]

In Roadmap

  • The version is shown. [as expected]
  • If the version is originating from another project; the project_name is integrated in the version name. [as expected]
  • The total number of open / closed tasks are shown (across all projects) [as expected]
  • The “related workpackages” only lists the tasks from the current selected project, instead of all included in the sprint [request to be changed]
  • When following link “x open”; the overview in Workpackages is opened in the project where the version is originating from. Only tasks of that project are in the overview [request to be changed]

Acceptance criteria

In Backlogs

  • In the taskboard: all tasks in the version are shown [Priority 1]

Nice to have

In Backlogs

  • In the burndown chart: all tasks in the version are shown [Priority 2]

In Roadmap

  • The “related workpackages” list of all tasks, with a reference to the originating project (name before / after workpackage number and name) [Priority 3]
  • When following link “x open”; an overview of all tasks in the version is shown. [Priority 4]

References (similar requests)

  • A similar request. Differing from the request though; I do not see a full list of workpackages in the roadmap (as per screenshot above): https://community.openproject.com/projects/openproject/work_packages/17189/activity.
  • A discussion on the forum describing the request: https://community.openproject.com/topics/3236
    Althought there seemed to be some support for the idea, the linked Pull Request is still on hold? https://github.com/finnlabs/openproject-backlogs/pull/233 This pull request is only focussing on subprojects though…
  • A similar request, focussed on sharing across subprojects, which is still a limitation which I do not see the need for. https://community.openproject.com/projects/plugin-backlogs/work_packages/22319/activity
  • A similar request. also focussed on subprojects only: https://community.openproject.com/projects/plugin-backlogs/work_packages/24971/activity
  • A request to remove limiting project\_id in the selection criteria of the overview; which might enable the requested functionality?: https://community.openproject.com/projects/plugin-backlogs/workpackages/24038/activity
    I tried the suggested hack, without success though, which might be related to the fact that the tasks are from different projects (not only subproject-relationship).

Next steps

  • I highly value your efforts and the Openproject software and hope by bringing this together, the software can be enhanced even further. I do think this is a key feature.
  • I am not a programmer, so not able to dig in this myself. I will post a Bounty to create a Pull Request for this additional feature.

description.raw: Currently there is only manual sorting the board view. There should be a way to switch to automatic sorting similar to the list. **As** an OpenProject user **I want to** be able to sort cards in a list in the boards module automatically **so that** the most important cards are on top of the list (e.g. highest priority, highest value for custom field X (e.g. votes), most logged time, ...). ### Acceptance criteria By using the menu (three dots) on top of the list I can access a dropdown field to choose whch attribute I want to sort by. Additionally, there's an option to choose/change if the sorting should be ascending or descending. Example/inspiration from Trello: https://trellocards.com/TCO/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/list-sorting.jpg
description.html:
Currently there is only manual sorting the board view. There should be a way to switch to automatic sorting similar to the list.

As an OpenProject user

I want to be able to sort cards in a list in the boards module automatically

so that the most important cards are on top of the list (e.g. highest priority, highest value for custom field X (e.g. votes), most logged time, ...).

Acceptance criteria

By using the menu (three dots) on top of the list I can access a dropdown field to choose whch attribute I want to sort by. Additionally, there's an option to choose/change if the sorting should be ascending or descending.

Example/inspiration from Trello: https://trellocards.com/TCO/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/list-sorting.jpg
